bio: Home Faculty Directory Michael Gregory is clinical professor of Law at HLS, where he teaches and practices law as part of the Trauma and Learning Policy Initiative (TLPI). TLPI is a partnership between HLS and Massachusetts Advocates for Children. TLPI's mission is to ensure that children traumatized by exposure to violence succeed in school. At HLS, Gregory co-teaches the Education Law Clinic with Susan Cole. Gregory has also taught Education Law and Policy and Education Reform Movements. Gregory received his J.D. from HLS in 2004, graduating cum laude. He has a B.A. in American Civilization and an M.A. in teaching, both from Brown University. Click here to see a full list of Michael Gregory’s courses. Email mgregory@law.harvard.edu Personal Site http://hls.harvard.edu/faculty/directory/10335/Gregory
